description: This file contains configuration logic and decision functions for Telegram network settings, including auto-select family and DNS result order, with environment variable and config-based overrides.

methods.name: isWSL2SyncCached
methods.description: Caches and returns the result of isWSL2Sync to optimize repeated checks.

methods.name: resolveTelegramAutoSelectFamilyDecision
methods.description: Determines whether to auto-select Telegram family based on environment, config, and WSL2 status.

methods.name: resolveTelegramDnsResultOrderDecision
methods.description: Determines DNS result order preference for Telegram network requests, prioritizing IPv4 on Node 22+ or based on environment/config.

methods.name: resetTelegramNetworkConfigStateForTests
methods.description: Resets internal cache for testing purposes.
